description: Erection of an outbuilding to rear garden
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (57BR-300-01A, 57BR-300-02B, 57BS-301-01D, Fire Safety Strategy - received 11th July 2022.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby approved must only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at 57 Basildene Road as described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (e.g. it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, living room or other primary residential accommodation.
